gates.D0_correctness_reproducibility: all scoring/invariant/capacity checks pass and duplicate runs are deterministic
gates.D1_mechanism_engagement: preserved unrelated assignments in >=25% of recovery episodes and non-equivalence to global-trail control
gates.D2_equal_resource_solve_retention: over_low independent_deepest >= monolith_MR - 0.10 and overall independent_deepest >= factorized_central_deepest - 0.10
gates.D3_aggregate_work_factorization: over_low mean cap-penalized independent_deepest work / monolith_MR work <= 0.85
gates.D4_bounded_decentralization_tax: jointly-solved independent_deepest/factorized_central_deepest work ratio <= 1.10 or compensating solve gain
gates.D5_route_identifiability: deepest vs random-valid differs by >=0.10 solve in an over cell or >=15% paired work
gates.D6_coordination_necessity: no-cross loses >=0.20 solve in an over cell or has a separated cross-recovery failure mode
